Definition: a vase (probably a vial tapering at the top)
BiblicalUsage: tsintseneth is the Bible's word for a pot, a jar. In Exodus 16:33, Take a pot, and put an omer full of manna therein.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the jar of manna kept in the ark reminds me God feeds His people and keeps the proof.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
